categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: electronic circuits (including flexible, rigid, and rigid-flex printed circuit boards), optoelectronic displays (LED devices, touch panels, and LCD modules), and precision manufacturing (precision metal structural parts and components). The company also has subsidiaries engaged in communication technology and related manufacturing. Its products serve industries such as consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, communication equipment, industrial control, AI, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including flexible printed circuits (FPC), rigid PCBs, rigid-flex PCBs, and high-density interconnect (HDI) boards. It employs precision manufacturing techniques such as die casting, stamping, sheet metal processing, and precision machining for metal components. In optoelectronics, it develops LED packaging technologies including Mini LED and Micro LED, and integrates touch and display modules. The company emphasizes R&D in AI, AR/VR, IoT, and automotive electronics, with a focus on smart manufacturing and digital transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global enterprises in consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, and communication equipment sectors. The company serves markets such as smartphones, tablets, wearable devices, automotive electronics (especially for new energy vehicles), industrial control, AI applications, and medical equipment. Its customer base is concentrated among top-tier international and domestic companies, with the top five customers accounting for over 70% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with headquarters and multiple manufacturing bases in Suzhou, Salt City, and other locations. It has a significant international presence with subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States, Singapore, Mexico, Thailand, Hungary, Mauritius, and Hong Kong. The company serves global markets, exporting over 80% of its products, and maintains operational and sales offices across North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongshan Precision operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing core components such as PCBs, LED devices, touch and display modules, and precision metal parts. It acts as a key supplier to downstream OEMs and system integrators in consumer electronics and automotive industries. The company also provides integrated solutions combining multiple product lines, enhancing its role as a comprehensive component supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on dual-core growth in consumer electronics and new energy vehicle sectors, with strong emphasis on embracing AI and digital transformation. It prioritizes R&D investment in advanced PCB technologies, Mini/Micro LED, automotive electronics including battery cooling and structural components, and smart manufacturing. The company fosters industry-academia collaborations, continuous innovation in materials and processes, and development of forward-looking products such as HUD displays and AI servers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of manufactured products including electronic circuits, LED display devices, touch and LCD display modules, and precision metal components. The company operates on an order-driven production model, fulfilling customer contracts with a focus on large-scale, high-volume manufacturing. It also receives government subsidies and engages in hedging activities to manage commodity and currency risks, which contribute to other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dongshan Precision is positioned as a leading global player in the PCB industry, ranking second worldwide in flexible circuit boards and third in overall PCB production by revenue. It is also a major domestic player in touch display modules and LED devices. The company competes with other top-tier global PCB and electronic component manufacturers, leveraging its scale, technology, and integrated product offerings to maintain competitive advantages in both consumer electronics and new energy vehicle markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 36.77 billion, representing a 9.27% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.09 billion, down 44.74% mainly due to asset impairment and restructuring in the LED segment. The company’s total assets reached RMB 46 billion with steady growth in equity. New energy business grew strongly by 36.98%, accounting for 23.52% of total revenue, indicating a robust growth trajectory in emerging sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongshan Precision emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio spanning electronic circuits, optoelectronic displays, and precision manufacturing, enabling it to offer integrated, one-stop solutions to customers. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced manufacturing capabilities, strong R&D and innovation in high-density and flexible PCBs, Mini/Micro LED technologies, and automotive electronics. The company’s scale, global footprint, and close collaboration with leading customers enhance its ability to deliver high-quality, technologically advanced core components tailored to evolving market demands.
